purpose: HOT Leads and the state BD trackers reconciled, on the Chair's approval of 25 November 2026. 426 Tier C rows move from the expansion files into each market's archive file, matching the trackers, which carry no Tier C. 209 repeated rows retire to the archive as duplicates of the row kept, the kept row being the one its tracker points at; any email, phone or decision maker only the repeat held is carried onto the kept row first. Nothing is deleted: every moved row sits in its archive with its reason and date. Held for the Chair: 27 repeat groups whose cities differ, and two whose rows disagree on status (Mike-sell's Potato Chip Company, Ohio; Nevada Beverage Company, Las Vegas). The tracker side merges 47 repeated rows. Count lines and index figures re-counted from the rows; verified companies stay at 3,685 and the emailable addresses at 613.
